system.effect: Lets the user see invisible phenomena and penetrate glamours up to Level 3 (emotional effects remain).
system.description: Alters perception to reveal active spells, wards, and possessing entities — at a cost. While active, fear/intimidation resistance is at Disadvantage and social Tests at +1 Difficulty; on activation, pass a DN 4:1 Spirit (Resolve) Test or become Frightened. Requisition DN 5:2; Certification Practical Occultism.
